verdict: AVGO AI revenue +221% YoY with $115B FY27 guide validates custom-silicon thesis; DRAM/HBM moderating +13-18% QoQ; no capex guide-down; HBM4 ahead of schedule raises 2027 correction risk.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24–72h)

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing:** 3Q26 conventional DRAM contract prices printing **+13–18% QoQ** per TrendForce, moderating sharply from Q1's record +81% QoQ. HBM negotiations remain stalled pending NVIDIA platform-spec finalization; contract prices retain "substantial upside." Memflation decelerating but still positive. *(Moderating bull)*

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp / Correction Risk:** SK Hynix shipped 12-layer HBM4 to NVIDIA **ahead of schedule** (June, vs. original September ramp). Micron targeting 100K HBM wafers/month by year-end with 12-Hi HBM4 ~50% of output. Samsung dedicating >60% of 2H26 HBM sales to HBM4. TechPowerUp reports SK Hynix is now **slowing its HBM4 ramp** (precise timing unclear) — a first sign the correction-risk signal is activating. No new commentary from SK Hynix this week. *(Mixed — supply building into 2027 on baseline track)*

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex:** No new guidance prints in the last 72h. Standing: Big 4 H1 2026 capex hit $301B; full-year guidance range now $630–732B (+~62% YoY). **No first guide-down detected.** *(Quiet — bull)*

**Signal 4 — AMD MI400/Helios + Custom ASICs:** AMD's Helios rack-scale platform (72× MI455X GPUs, $5.25M/rack, 2.9 EF FP4) launched July 22-23 at Advancing AI 2026. OpenAI + Meta booked combined 12 GW AMD capacity; MSFT Azure and Oracle named early customers. Google TPU, AWS Trainium, Meta MTIA continuing custom-silicon fragmentation. No new AMD/ASIC-specific news this week. *(Launch confirmed — on baseline)*

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics:** CRDO Q1 FY2027 (reported Sept 1): revenue $1.34B (**+206% YoY**), EPS beat; ZeroFlap optical transceivers announced. COHR/LITE/AAOI surged on AI optical demand (around Sept 7). COHR now -24% monthly (consolidation after 53% YTD run). No new transceiver lead-time data this week. *(Bull on demand, pulling back on price)*

**Signal 6 — Solar:** Trump 15% polysilicon tariff + $0.38/W price floor confirmed effective **Dec 4** (announced Aug 6). FSLR endorsed tariffs, stock +18.5%; reaffirmed $4.9–5.2B FY26 guidance, 17.0–18.2 GW volume. ENPH +6%, ARRY +5% on the tariff rally. No new news this week. *(Bull for domestic producers; bear for importers)*

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| AVGO | –4% on Q3 earnings day (Sept 2) | Record Q3 $29.6B rev (+86% YoY); AI rev $16.7B (+221%); **Q4 guidance missed** expectations → sold off |
| MRVL | +5.4% | AI interconnect / custom-silicon demand momentum; specific catalyst unclear |
| CRDO | Strong (earnings week, Sept 1) | Q1 FY27 rev +206% YoY; ZeroFlap optical products |
| ALAB | Sharp rally | S&P 500 inclusion speculation (Sept 4) |
| NVDA | +0.57% Sept 16 | No material news; trading $213.26 |
| COHR | –24% monthly | Post-run consolidation; 53% YTD gain still intact |

*No notable moves on MU, WDC, SNDK, RMBS, HIVE, FSLR/ENPH/ARRY (post-tariff rally faded), NOW, ZS, TSLA, NOK, AMPX, ALMU this week.*

---

## Context (vs Baseline)

- **AVGO XPU thesis confirmed at scale**: $58B FY26 AI guide (raised), $115B FY27, $230B FY28. Six XPU hyperscaler customers with 3.5× YoY shipment growth. This validates and likely front-runs the ARK ">1/3 compute by 2030" custom-silicon call.
- **HBM4 ahead of baseline schedule**: SK Hynix June start vs. September plan means 2026 supply is tighter-for-longer, but 2027 correction risk intensifies as all three suppliers now fully ramping.
- **DRAM memflation moderating** (+13–18% QoQ vs. +81% in Q1) — expected on high-base effects, not a reversal signal.
- **Solar tariff structure confirmed** — FSLR is the clearest beneficiary (no polysilicon exposure); ENPH/ARRY face more ambiguity.

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| DRAM conventional pricing | +13–18% QoQ, decelerating | Mild bull |
| HBM pricing | Negotiations stalled; upside retained | Neutral → bull near-term; **bear 2027** |
| HBM4 ramp pace | Ahead of schedule, SK Hynix slowing | **Bear flag — 2027 correction on track** |
| Hyperscaler capex | No guide-down; $630–732B | Bull |
| Custom-ASIC share shift (AVGO XPU) | 3.5× YoY, $115B FY27 guide | Bull AVGO/ecosystem; mild bear NVDA share |
| Optical (CRDO/COHR/LITE) | Structural demand intact; COHR consolidating | Bull |
| Solar tariffs | Dec 4 effective, price floors | Bull FSLR; mixed ENPH/ARRY |

---

## Most Important Development

**AVGO Q3 FY2026** (reported Sept 2): AI revenue $16.7B (+221% YoY), XPU shipments 3.5× YoY, FY27 AI guide $115B, FY28 $230B. This is the week's defining data point — the single clearest public quantification of the custom-silicon/hyperscaler buildout. The –4% stock reaction to a Q4 guidance miss is noise; the structural $115B→$230B step-up validates the full baseline thesis.

---
